services.name: Flower
services.blurb: Every jar shows its test date, THC percentage and price per gram on the tag.

services.name: Pre-rolls
services.blurb: Singles and packs priced per gram, so you can compare them with loose flower.

services.name: Edibles
services.blurb: Milligrams per piece and per pack printed on the menu, not only on the box.

services.name: Vapes & cartridges
services.blurb: Cartridges listed with batch code and test date; ask for the lab sheet anytime.

services.name: Concentrates
services.blurb: Live resin, rosin and badder, each labelled with how it was made and tested.

services.name: Tinctures
services.blurb: Milligrams per dropper and per bottle side by side, so the math is done.

services.name: CBD products
services.blurb: CBD oils and balms with the CBD and THC amounts listed on one line.

services.name: Accessories
services.blurb: Grinders, papers, glass and storage jars, with prices marked on the shelf.

services.name: Online pre-order
services.blurb: The online menu shows the same tags as the store; pay and pick up here.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The tag on every jar has the test date and the price per gram. I shop three stores in town and this is the only one where I don't need a calculator.
reviews.name: Kyle P.

reviews.text: Asked to see the lab sheet for a cartridge and they pulled it up on the counter screen without any fuss. Batch number matched the box. That's all I wanted.
reviews.name: Anika S.

reviews.text: Menu price plus the tax line came to exactly what I paid at the register. Sounds basic, but it has not been my experience elsewhere in Michigan.
reviews.name: Marcus L.

reviews.text: Lake-effect morning, roads were bad. Pre-ordered from the kitchen, waited in the car, held my ID up to the window and was home in fifteen minutes.
reviews.name: Dorothy V.

reviews.text: I'm 68 and new to all of this. The young man explained milligrams per piece with a pen on the back of the receipt and suggested I start with a quarter. Patient and clear.
reviews.name: Harold B.

reviews.text: Rosin is priced per gram on the board with the extraction date next to it. Fresher batches are marked. Easy to pick, easy to come back for the same one.
reviews.name: Jonah F.

reviews.text: Short visit, clean store, numbers on everything. Got in and out on a Friday at five in under ten minutes with a pre-order.
reviews.name: Shay N.

proof.guarantee: If the shelf tag and the register disagree, you pay the lower price.
